description.narrative: Projektet förväntas bidra till följande övergripande mål: att PURS omvandlas till en modern, transparent och inkluderande myndighet som är lyhörd för behoven hos sin personal, sina överordnade, partners och skattebetalare.

The project is expected to contribute to the following overarching goal: PURS is transformed into a modern, transparent, and inclusive authority that is responsive to the needs of its staff, managers, partners and taxpayers.

Within its overarching goal (purpose), the project will work on achieving the following key objective: at the end of the project, PURS is an organisation with a workplace culture that actively promotes continuous improvement, higher employee engagement and effective performance management.
The project will consist of the two components:
- Human Resource Management component and,
- Exploratory component.
The project envisages the following four outcomes, where the first three are related to the first component (HRM) and the fourth one to the second, exploratory component:
1) Serbian Tax Authority is an attractive employer with high employee satisfaction
2) Improved strategic competences of the Human Resource Management (HRM) department
3) Enhanced system for continuous monitoring of staff development
4) Improved knowledge and ability to deal with external and internal challenges
